test.title: A time when you saw a wild animal

document.cue: Describe a time when you saw a wild animal.

text: A few years ago I was lucky enough to see a herd of saigas — a kind of antelope that lives only on the steppes of Central Asia and has a strange, oversized nose. They're quite rare, so it's not something most people in my country ever see in the wild.

It happened during a family road trip to the west of Kazakhstan in late spring. We were driving along an empty road in the middle of the steppe, and my uncle, who was at the wheel, suddenly stopped the car and pointed at the horizon.

At first I could only see dust, but then I realised there were dozens of animals running together. They were moving incredibly fast and in perfect formation, as if someone was guiding them. After a minute or two, they stopped to graze, and we watched them through binoculars for about half an hour without saying a word.

I felt a mixture of excitement and something close to respect. Not long ago, saigas almost died out because of disease and illegal hunting, so knowing that their numbers have recovered made the moment feel genuinely meaningful.
It's honestly one of the most memorable things I've ever seen, and I'd love to go back one day with my own camera.

note.ru: Где и когда — поездка, степь, дядя за рулём.

note.en: What the animals were doing — the scene step by step: dust, running, rest.
note.kk: Жануарлар не істеді — көрініс кезең-кезеңімен: шаң, жүгіріс, демалыс.

note.en: Feelings — with an explanation of why the moment meant so much.

note.en: A warm ending and a wish to go back.
note.kk: Жылы қорытынды және қайта барғысы келетіні.
